summary: When self is NaN, f16::max incorrectly returns NaN for a non-NaN other operand because other > self is false. The fix explicitly checks self.is_nan() and returns other. This reversal isolates f16::max; the upstream test added by the fix checks that NaN.max(42) returns 42. No tests were executed.
expected_failure:
assertion `left == right` failed
  left: NaN
 right: 42.0
